message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout right during dinner! I was scrambling to find the flashlights, but all I could find were those tiny keychain ones that barely lit up the room. After a few moments of frantic searching, I finally uncovered our trusty lantern in the closet—thank goodness! It turned into a cozy little picnic in the living room, complete with snacks we could still munch on. A little chaos can turn into a fun family memory, but it definitely reminded me to keep everything organized for next time. What are your favorite tips for staying comfy when the lights go out?
